selected.text: I swear by Him Who hath fashioned Me from the light of His own Beauty!  None have I ever seen that surpasseth you in heedlessness or exceedeth you in ignorance.  Ye seek to prove your faith in God through such holy Tablets as ye possess, yet when the verses of God were revealed and His Lamp was lighted, ye disbelieved in Him Whose very Pen hath fixed the destinies of all things in the Preserved Tablet.  Ye recite the sacred verses and yet repudiate Him Who is their Source and Revealer.  Thus hath God blinded your eyes in requital for your deeds, would ye but understand.  Day and night ye transcribe the verses of God, and yet ye remain shut out, as by a veil, from Him Who hath revealed them
